summary: Faster food logging: servings next to serving size, recently logged at the top, my meals in one tap, recipes, adding to several days, a % of today's targets preview, often-eaten-with foods, fiber/sugar/sodium, and an Import My foods JSON file (new myMeals store, database v7, backup schema 7).
why: The owner wanted MyFitnessPal's add-food shortcuts in genki.
